system.notes:
Seattle Downtown district's public access Matrix node. AR advertising, transit schedules, permit kiosks, event listings, and basic government services. Thousands of users daily; Overwatch accumulates slowly here due to high traffic noise.

Notable data: Almost nothing worth stealing on its own — but a useful unmonitored launch point to reach adjacent hosts without surfacing your physical location.

nodes.name: System Access Node
nodes.description: High-traffic public gateway. Flooded with legitimate user traffic — Overwatch builds slowly here.

nodes.name: I/O Port
nodes.description: Metro Centre jackpoint cluster. Four public sockets on the concourse level.

nodes.name: I/O Port
nodes.description: Street-level AR kiosk row. Unmonitored pedestrian terminals along 3rd Avenue.

nodes.name: Sub-Processing Unit
nodes.description: Routes advertising feeds, transit data, and permit requests. Very high legitimate traffic.

nodes.name: Slave Node
nodes.description: Controls AR billboard arrays, transit announcement boards, and public kiosk displays.

nodes.name: Data Store
nodes.description: Public records: transit schedules, permit filings, event registrations, AR ad contracts.

nodes.name: Central Processing Unit
nodes.description: Administers city service APIs and manages sysop access. Lightly defended — this host's value is in availability, not secrecy.

ioPorts.name: Metro Centre Concourse Sockets
ioPorts.physicalLocation: 4 public jackpoints on the main concourse level of Metro Centre, 3rd & Pine.

ioPorts.name: 3rd Avenue AR Kiosk Row
ioPorts.physicalLocation: 6 unmonitored street-facing kiosk terminals along 3rd Avenue between Pike and Union.

triggerSteps.label: TS 1
triggerSteps.description: Alert (Passive) activates. System logs the anomalous access signature and flags it for automated review. No active response yet — traffic volume masks the alert.

triggerSteps.label: TS 2
triggerSteps.description: ARis deploys at SPU. Begins tracking the intruder's persona icon. Low rating — may lose track in heavy traffic. Overwatch begins accumulating.

triggerSteps.label: TS 3
triggerSteps.description: Authenticator activates at SAN. Begins re-validating all active sessions. Legitimate users notice a brief slowdown. Intruder's credentials are re-checked against city registry.

triggerSteps.label: TS 4
triggerSteps.description: Automated lockout triggers on the DS. Public permit and event data remains readable but write access is suspended. A sysop receives an automated page.

triggerSteps.label: TS 5
triggerSteps.description: SN billboard arrays begin looping 'SYSTEM MAINTENANCE' banners. Physical security notified at Metro Centre. I/O Port 1 access suspended pending review.

triggerSteps.label: TS 6
triggerSteps.description: Partial shutdown of public-facing SPU processes. Transit data goes to read-only cached mode. City IT department alerted.

triggerSteps.label: TS 7
triggerSteps.description: CPU initiates emergency passcode rotation. All active sessions forcibly terminated and re-authenticated. System effectively reboots for 1d6 minutes.

triggerSteps.label: TS 8
triggerSteps.description: Full host lockdown. All I/O ports physically disabled (electronic lock on kiosk panels). Host switches to emergency-services-only mode. GOD pinged.

triggerSteps.label: TS 9
triggerSteps.description: Convergence. GOD response team dispatched. Physical location of active jackpoints traced. Decker's SAN connection logged with timestamp. Expect a Lone Star visit within 4d6 minutes.
